remoteSensingSolutions.headline: Remote Sensing Solutions
remoteSensingSolutions.description: SmartGrid Surveying provides precise GIS and remote sensing services — from UAV photogrammetry, LiDAR mapping, to multispectral analysis and DEM creation. We deliver accurate spatial data to support planning, engineering, and environmental projects across Kenya and Africa.

items.title: Multispectral Analysis
items.description: Capture data across multiple spectral bands for agriculture, vegetation health, and environmental monitoring.

items.title: Feature Extraction
items.description: Identify and digitize geographic features such as buildings, roads, water bodies, and land cover from imagery.

items.title: Volumetric Calculations
items.description: Compute volumes of stockpiles, cut/fill operations, and resource deposits with high precision.

items.title: Land Use/Land Cover
items.description: Classify and map land use categories and land cover types for planning and environmental management.

mappingServices.headline: Mapping Services
mappingServices.description: SmartGrid Surveying provides precise GIS and remote sensing services — from UAV photogrammetry, LiDAR mapping, to multispectral analysis and DEM creation. We deliver accurate spatial data to support planning, engineering, and environmental projects across Kenya and Africa.

items.title: Drone Photogrammetry
items.description: High-resolution orthomosaics and point clouds for accurate site modeling and volumetrics.

items.title: LiDAR Mapping
items.description: Precise terrain and vegetation models using UAV or terrestrial LiDAR.

items.title: DEM & DSM Production
items.description: Digital Elevation Models and contour maps for planning and engineering.

gisComponents.headline: GIS Components
gisComponents.description: Our GIS solutions integrate hardware, software, data, people, and methods to create comprehensive spatial analysis and mapping systems.

list.title: Hardware
list.description: Physical tools like computers, servers, GPS devices, and drones that support GIS operations.

list.title: Software
list.description: GIS applications such as ArcGIS, QGIS, and Google Earth Engine used for data processing and visualization.

list.title: Data
list.description: The geographic information: raster images, vector files, tables, and metadata that form the core of GIS.

list.title: People
list.description: GIS professionals and users who interpret, apply, and communicate geospatial insights.

list.title: Methods
list.description: Standardized procedures and analytical techniques used in GIS workflows for accurate decision-making.
